mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bazi_record (name, gender, birth_time, calendar_type, tz_offset, longitude, city_name, true_solar, year_gz, month_gz, day_gz, hour_gz, day_master, chart_json, analysis_json) VALUES (#{name}, #{gender}, #{birthTime}, #{calendarType}, #{tzOffset}, #{longitude}, #{cityName}, #{trueSolar}, #{yearGz}, #{monthGz}, #{dayGz}, #{hourGz}, #{dayMaster}, #{chartJson}, #{analysisJson})
mapper.select: SELECT day_master AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM bazi_record WHERE day_master IS NOT NULL AND day_master <> '' GROUP BY day_master ORDER BY value DESC
